import json
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

with open("/tmp/all_tags_raw.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

notes = data["notes"]
tags = data["tags"]

print(f"Notes analyzed: {len(notes)}")
print(f"Tag instances: {len(tags)}")

# 1. Basic counts
unique_tags = set(t["name"] for t in tags)
print(f"Unique tag names: {len(unique_tags)}")

# 2. By type
type_counts = Counter(t["type"] for t in tags)
unique_by_type = defaultdict(set)
for t in tags:
    unique_by_type[t["type"]].add(t["name"])

print("\n=== Tag Type Distribution ===")
for t, cnt in type_counts.most_common():
    print(f"  {t}: {cnt} instances, {len(unique_by_type[t])} unique names")

# 3. Top 20 most frequent tags
name_counts = Counter(t["name"] for t in tags)
print("\n=== TOP 20 Frequent Tags ===")
for name, cnt in name_counts.most_common(20):
    types = set(t["type"] for t in tags if t["name"] == name)
    print(f"  [{cnt:4d}] {name}  (type: {', '.join(types)})")

# 4. One-time tags (appear only once)
one_time = [(n, c) for n, c in name_counts.items() if c == 1]
print(f"\n=== One-time Tags (appear once): {len(one_time)} ===")
for name, cnt in sorted(one_time, key=lambda x: x[0])[:50]:
    print(f"  {name}")

# 5. Tag length distribution
lengths = [len(name) for name in unique_tags]
print(f"\n=== Tag Name Length Distribution ===")
print(f"  Min: {min(lengths)}, Max: {max(lengths)}, Avg: {sum(lengths)/len(lengths):.1f}")
len_buckets = Counter()
for l in lengths:
    if l <= 2: bucket = "1-2"
    elif l <= 4: bucket = "3-4"
    elif l <= 6: bucket = "5-6"
    elif l <= 8: bucket = "7-8"
    elif l <= 12: bucket = "9-12"
    else: bucket = "13+"
    len_buckets[bucket] += 1
for b, cnt in sorted(len_buckets.items()):
    print(f"  {b} chars: {cnt} tags")

# 6. Notes with no tags
notes_no_tags = sum(1 for n in notes if len(n["tags"]) == 0)
notes_with_tags = sum(1 for n in notes if len(n["tags"]) > 0)
print(f"\n=== Notes Coverage ===")
print(f"  With tags: {notes_with_tags} ({notes_with_tags/len(notes)*100:.1f}%)")
print(f"  Without tags: {notes_no_tags} ({notes_no_tags/len(notes)*100:.1f}%)")

# 7. Notes per tag count distribution
tag_per_note = Counter(len(n["tags"]) for n in notes)
print(f"\n=== Tags per Note Distribution ===")
for cnt, num_notes in sorted(tag_per_note.items()):
    print(f"  {cnt} tags: {num_notes} notes")

# 8. System vs AI vs Manual tag analysis
print("\n=== By Type - Top Tags ===")
for t in ["system", "ai", "manual", "unknown"]:
    if t in unique_by_type:
        t_tags = [(n, c) for n, c in name_counts.items() if n in unique_by_type[t]]
        t_tags.sort(key=lambda x: -x[1])
        print(f"\n  [{t}] top 10:")
        for n, c in t_tags[:10]:
            print(f"    [{c:4d}] {n}")

# 9. Semantic clustering (find potential duplicates)
print("\n=== Potential Semantic Duplicates ===")
# Find tags that are substrings of others or very similar
tag_list = sorted(unique_tags, key=len)
duplicates = []
for i, t1 in enumerate(tag_list):
    for t2 in tag_list[i+1:]:
        if t1 in t2 and len(t1) >= 3:
            duplicates.append((t1, t2))
        # Also check Chinese similarity (same prefix)
        if len(t1) >= 4 and len(t2) >= 4 and t1[:4] == t2[:4] and t1 != t2:
            duplicates.append((t1, t2))
print(f"  Found {len(duplicates)} potential duplicate pairs (substring relationships):")
for d in duplicates[:30]:
    c1 = name_counts[d[0]]
    c2 = name_counts[d[1]]
    print(f"    '{d[0]}' ({c1}) ⊂ '{d[1]}' ({c2})")

# 10. AI tags breakdown
ai_tags = [t for t in tags if t["type"] == "ai"]
print(f"\n=== AI Tags Analysis ===")
print(f"  Total AI tag instances: {len(ai_tags)}")
ai_unique = set(t["name"] for t in ai_tags)
print(f"  Unique AI tag names: {len(ai_unique)}")
ai_name_counts = Counter(t["name"] for t in ai_tags)
print(f"  Top AI tags:")
for n, c in ai_name_counts.most_common(20):
    print(f"    [{c}] {n}")

# 11. System tags breakdown
sys_tags = [t for t in tags if t["type"] == "system"]
sys_unique = set(t["name"] for t in sys_tags)
print(f"\n=== System Tags Analysis ===")
print(f"  Total system tag instances: {len(sys_tags)}")
print(f"  Unique system tag names: {len(sys_unique)}")
sys_name_counts = Counter(t["name"] for t in sys_tags)
print(f"  Top system tags:")
for n, c in sys_name_counts.most_common(20):
    print(f"    [{c}] {n}")

# 12. Tags with special characters or patterns
print("\n=== Tags with Special Patterns ===")
emoji_tags = [n for n in unique_tags if any(ord(c) > 127 for c in n) or any(c in n for c in "🔖📌💡⭐")]
chinese_tags = [n for n in unique_tags if any('\u4e00' <= c <= '\u9fff' for c in n)]
print(f"  Tags with emoji/unicode: {len(emoji_tags)}")
print(f"  Tags with Chinese: {len(chinese_tags)}")

# 13. Serialize for report
report_data = {
    "notes_analyzed": len(notes),
    "tag_instances": len(tags),
    "unique_tags": len(unique_tags),
    "type_distribution": dict(type_counts),
    "top20": name_counts.most_common(20),
    "one_time_count": len(one_time),
    "one_time_tags": sorted([n for n, c in name_counts.items() if c == 1]),
    "length_dist": dict(len_buckets),
    "notes_with_tags": notes_with_tags,
    "notes_without_tags": notes_no_tags,
    "tags_per_note": dict(sorted(tag_per_note.items())),
    "ai_tags_top": ai_name_counts.most_common(30),
    "sys_tags_top": sys_name_counts.most_common(30),
    "potential_duplicates": duplicates[:30],
}

with open("/tmp/tag_analysis_data.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(report_data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
print("\nAnalysis data saved to /tmp/tag_analysis_data.json")
